panels.description: For the selected user in the time range. Switches: counted permission mode switches. Sessions with a switch: sessions with at least one. Switches per session: switches over the user's sessions with prompts in the range. Shift+Tab share: share of switches made with Shift+Tab. Plans approved: switches out of Plan made by approving its plan; leaving Plan with Shift+Tab isn't counted here. /plan: plan mode entered with /plan. Auto-gate denials: Auto refused an action and dropped to Agentic. No trigger reported: switches whose Claude Code version gave no trigger. Startup applying the configured default mode is not counted.

targets.rawSql:
-- sw is the user's counted switches in the range; ss is their sessions with prompts in the range.
WITH sw AS (
  SELECT m.session_id, m.`trigger`
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring}
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
),
ss AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions FROM ai_prompts p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at) AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COUNT(sw.session_id) AS "Switches",
  COUNT(DISTINCT sw.session_id) AS "Sessions with a switch",
  COUNT(sw.session_id) / NULLIF(MAX(ss.sessions), 0) AS "Switches per session",
  SUM(sw.`trigger` = 'shift_tab') / NULLIF(COUNT(sw.session_id), 0) AS "Shift+Tab share",
  COALESCE(SUM(sw.`trigger` = 'exit_plan_mode'), 0) AS "Plans approved",
  COALESCE(SUM(sw.`trigger` = 'plan_command'), 0) AS "/plan",
  COALESCE(SUM(sw.`trigger` = 'auto_gate_denied'), 0) AS "Auto-gate denials",
  COALESCE(SUM(sw.`trigger` = ''), 0) AS "No trigger reported"
FROM ss
LEFT JOIN sw ON TRUE

panels.title: Switching Summary

panels.description: One row per Claude Code session of the selected user, from its first prompt's start to its last prompt's end, coloured by the permission mode in effect. The colour changes at each mode switch and at each prompt whose mode was reported; Inferred means nothing revealed the session's starting mode. Startup applying the configured default mode is not drawn as a switch. Shows the 30 most recently active sessions in the range. Rows are labelled with the session's repository (GH:, GL: or BB: and its path, or Unknown) and the first 8 characters of its session ID. Times are shown in your browser's timezone.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is the user's prompts overlapping the range, shown keeps the 30 most recently active sessions,
-- and sw is their counted switches. Each session draws as one bar that changes colour with the mode.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.workspace_key, p.session_id, p.started_at, p.ended_at, p.repository_url, p.permission_mode, p.permission_mode_inferred
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- Prompts that overlap the time range, so a prompt that began before the range still shows.
  WHERE p.started_at < $__timeTo() AND p.ended_at > $__timeFrom()
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
), s AS (
  SELECT workspace_key, session_id,
    MAX(repository_url) AS repository_url,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_start,
    MAX(ended_at) AS last_end,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(ended_at) DESC, session_id) AS recency
  FROM base
  GROUP BY workspace_key, session_id
), shown AS (
  SELECT s.workspace_key, s.session_id, s.first_start, s.last_end,
    CONCAT(CASE
        WHEN s.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
        -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
        ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://', '')
      END, ' · ', LEFT(s.session_id, 8)) AS session_label
  FROM s
  WHERE s.recency <= 30
), sw AS (
  SELECT m.workspace_key, m.session_id, m.changed_at, m.to_mode
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  JOIN shown ON shown.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND shown.session_id = m.session_id
  WHERE m.changed_at <= shown.last_end
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
)
SELECT t AS time, session, state
FROM (
  -- A session starts in its first prompt's mode, Inferred when nothing revealed it, unless a switch came first.
  SELECT shown.first_start AS t, 0 AS kind, shown.session_label AS session,
    IF(fp.permission_mode_inferred, 'Inferred', CASE fp.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END) AS state
  FROM shown
  JOIN base fp ON fp.workspace_key = shown.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = shown.session_id AND fp.started_at = shown.first_start
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw WHERE sw.workspace_key = shown.workspace_key AND sw.session_id = shown.session_id AND sw.changed_at < shown.first_start)
  UNION ALL
  -- Later prompts whose mode was reported; inferred ones keep the mode before them.
  SELECT b.started_at, 1, shown.session_label, CASE b.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END
  FROM base b
  JOIN shown ON shown.workspace_key = b.workspace_key AND shown.session_id = b.session_id
  WHERE NOT b.permission_mode_inferred AND b.started_at > shown.first_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sw.changed_at, 1, shown.session_label, CASE sw.to_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END
  FROM sw
  JOIN shown ON shown.workspace_key = sw.workspace_key AND shown.session_id = sw.session_id
  UNION ALL
  -- After the last prompt the state is NULL, so the row shows nothing until the range ends.
  SELECT last_end, 2, session_label, NULL
  FROM shown
) pts
ORDER BY t, kind

panels.title: Session Modes

panels.description: The selected user's switches in the time range, with the mode switched from as rows and the mode switched to as columns; each cell is a switch count, darker for more. Total is the row's switches. 'Before /plan' is a switch made with /plan, where Claude Code doesn't report the mode before it. Startup applying the configured default mode is not counted. Other is any mode not listed.

targets.rawSql:
-- sw is every counted switch in the range whose session matches the filters.
WITH sw AS (
  SELECT CASE m.from_mode WHEN '' THEN 'Before /plan' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END AS f, m.to_mode
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring}
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
)
SELECT f AS "From ↓ / To →",
  SUM(to_mode = 'default') AS "Agentic",
  SUM(to_mode = 'auto') AS "Auto",
  SUM(to_mode = 'acceptEdits') AS "Accept Edits",
  SUM(to_mode = 'plan') AS "Plan",
  SUM(to_mode = 'bypassPermissions') AS "Bypass Permissions",
  SUM(to_mode NOT IN ('default', 'auto', 'acceptEdits', 'plan', 'bypassPermissions')) AS "Other",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total"
FROM sw
GROUP BY f
ORDER BY FIELD(f, 'Agentic', 'Auto', 'Accept Edits', 'Plan', 'Bypass Permissions', 'Other', 'Before /plan')

panels.title: Mode Flow

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
-- The viewer's own email sorts first, so the dashboard opens on their sessions.
ORDER BY u.user = ${__user.email:sqlstring} DESC, 1;

-- Repositories the selected user's prompts ran in during the time range, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
